title: Concept: PyYAML load without a safe loader (python)
description: PyYAML yaml.load without a safe loader can build arbitrary objects from YAML tags. Untrusted YAML can run code. The remedy is yaml.safe_load(stream).
applicability: Python code parsing YAML from files, requests, or stored data; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution from attacker-supplied YAML; HIGH severity.
